data.name: Description
data.value: Manage reusable firewall rule definitions and their authoring metadata.

data.name: InventoryDescription
data.value: Templates are independent authoring definitions. They do not represent live firewall state or rule positions.

data.name: NoTemplates
data.value: No rule templates have been created yet.

data.name: DeleteDialogDescription
data.value: Delete template “{0}”? This does not affect any live firewall rules.

data.name: LoadFailed
data.value: Rule templates could not be loaded

data.name: CreateDescription
data.value: Define a reusable rule and metadata snapshot without changing the live firewall.

data.name: EditDescription
data.value: Update this reusable rule definition without changing any live firewall rule.

data.name: TemplateDetailsDescription
data.value: Name the reusable definition and optionally describe when it should be used.

data.name: RuleDefinitionDescription
data.value: Define reusable UFW rule fields. Current firewall capabilities and rule-set state do not constrain template storage.

data.name: TemplateMetadataDescription
data.value: Notes, tags, and group membership are copied when this template initializes a rule draft.

data.name: TemplateNotFoundDescription
data.value: The requested template no longer exists or is not available.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: Rule template could not be saved

data.name: SaveLiveRuleDescription
data.value: Save the reviewed rule and its current notes, tags, and group as a reusable template. This does not change the firewall.

data.name: LoadTemplateDescription
data.value: Load reusable rule fields and metadata into this draft. You can review and change them before signing the firewall mutation.

data.name: TemplateLoaded
data.value: Template “{0}” loaded into the rule draft.

data.name: TemplateLoadFailed
data.value: Rule templates could not be loaded. You can continue creating the rule without a template.

data.name: TemplateContextInvalid
data.value: The requested template identifier is invalid. The current rule draft was left unchanged.

data.name: TemplateContextMissing
data.value: The requested rule template no longer exists. The current rule draft was left unchanged.

data.name: TemplateFamilyMismatch
data.value: Template “{0}” uses {1}, but this ordered insertion is fixed to {2}. The current rule draft was left unchanged.

data.name: DisableLiveRuleDescription
data.value: Save the reviewed rule and its metadata as a template, then delete the live firewall rule. The rule is deleted only after template persistence is confirmed.

data.name: DisableMetadataPreserved
data.value: Notes, tags, and group membership are copied into the template. Group membership is retained; disabling a rule never deletes its group.

data.name: DisableWarning
data.value: Continuing deletes the active firewall rule. The saved template is retained even if deletion fails or its outcome cannot be confirmed.

data.name: DisableCompleted
data.value: Rule disabled and saved as template “{0}”.

data.name: DisableTemplatePersistenceNotConfirmed
data.value: The live rule was not disabled because template persistence could not be confirmed. No firewall delete was issued. Refresh the template catalog to check whether the template was created. {0}

data.name: DisableFirewallDeleteNotConfirmed
data.value: Template “{0}” was saved, but disabling the live rule could not be confirmed: {1}

data.name: DisableUnexpectedFailure
data.value: The disable workflow could not be completed: {0}
